notes: One entry per style id. Only styles with a prompt block (engine/styles/<id>-*.prompt.md) can go to Make, and every style here has one. Edit every field by hand.
exemplars are repo-relative paths to one cover and one interior, 4:5. shared/build-gallery.mjs draws them as the style's tile and fails if a file is missing.

No style has stats yet. When you post a deck, add "stats": { "last_used": "YYYY-MM-DD" } to its style so the cooldown works. uses, median_mult and best_mult are optional; node shared/build-gallery.mjs --sync fills them (with posts, interior_posts and drafts) from your own post log if you keep one. Without --sync the script never writes this file (see engine/styles/README.md).

cooldown_days: a style posted within this many days shows as cooling on the pick sheet, and the skill will not recommend it. Styles tend to decay with repetition. The shipped worked example (carousels/2026-10-14-claude-video-free) does not count toward cooldown.

{{BRAND}} in attributes and prompt blocks is the name in engine/brand.json. {{MONTH_YEAR}} (e.g. OCTOBER ©2026) comes from the deck folder's date. The skill fills both in when it writes prompts and when it copies an HTML template into a deck.

styles.name: Phone-Photo Monitor
styles.one_line: A phone photo of your monitor showing the real thing (README, tool, title screen), with white TikTok-style caption stickers. Your own photo when you have one, else a Codex plate of the desk with the real capture warped onto its screen.

formats.notes: Repo listicle and quick tips (C): cover = desk view with the title screen or the best item's hero; one item per slide on alternating canted / close plates, stickers '1) Name' + one or two plain sentences + 'github.com/owner/repo'. Explainer (A) only when every role has a real screen to show (what = the tool's page, how / use = real runs, peak / start = a zoomed capture with the command in the link sticker; a model diagram is an S11 card shown on the screen). Not for B or D: a side-by-side test or a parts diagram needs a layout, and this style's point is having none.

attributes.ground: A phone photo of a monitor on a home desk like this: green plant wall, softbox lamp edge, webcam on the bezel, wooden desk; warm light or a deep red wash. Your photo, or a Codex plate of the same kind of room
attributes.panel: The monitor's screen: a real capture or kits/S05/screen-title.html, perspective-warped onto the plate's magenta screen with a photographed-screen look
attributes.ornament: None, apart from a small white 'N/T' counter sticker

exemplars.note: Cover of a '3 GitHub repos' deck (browser tabs and taskbar blurred) and slide 3 of a '5 repos' deck shot in a red-lit room (tabs and tray blurred).

requires: Screen content is always real: captures via shared/shots.py or the Browser pane / playwright (faces and avatars cropped or scrubbed), or kits/S05/screen-title.html for the cover (pixel wordmark, optional real mark from $D/logos/, optional mascot PNG: your own mascot, if you have one; never a licensed character)

Photos, best first: (1) you shoot the real screen (no Codex, no keying); (2) you shoot the monitor once per angle showing a full-screen #FF00FF page, then the warp step; (3) Codex plates: 1 cover (desk view) + 2 interior views (canted, close), refs engine/styles/refs/s05-ref-{desk,canted,close}.png (screen keyed magenta, stickers inpainted), the locked cover first on interiors. The room is painted in mode 3; the screen never is

Warp step: composite.py --shot N=path@x,y,w,h,warp[,extend=left|right][,aspect=W:H] (perspective onto the magenta quad, photographed-screen look, loose key; leftover must be 0) straight to fitted/slide-NN.png, on every view including the desk cover

Every word is a sticker in kits/S05/caption.html (title <= 12 words, body <= 34, link <= 48 characters, at most 3 a slide), rendered full frame with render-card --min-px 30 to final/; numbers verified on posting day
storyboard.json per slide: view (desk | canted | close), screen (shot path or screen-title), stickers[] {role, text, y?, h?, align?}. Stage 4 route in .claude/skills/carousel/SKILL.md

styles.name: Statue Cover + Graph-Paper Cards
styles.one_line: A marble statue offering one real logo tile against a changing sky, with huge white wordmark type; interiors are graph-paper repo cards.

formats.notes: Top-N lists and repo / tool roundups (C): one Template 01 layered slide per item ('#N: Name' + what it does, the real capture, a verified repo card, one body line), CTA with one Comment KEYWORD action. Explainer (A) on the single-image slide (one capture or an S11 diagram card per role, repo card only on start); the cover drops the TOP N kicker. Not for B or D. Decays with repetition: change statue, gesture and sky every deck (block's Rotation table).

attributes.ground: Cover: a sky that changes every deck (cobalt #3D7DC8 -> #7AB0DE is the default and the most worn; then golden hour, overcast, dusk, sea, alpine). Interiors: cream + 60px graph-paper grid
attributes.character: Marble statue (Codex plate) offering one real logo tile on an open palm (cyan slot, kits/S06/tile.html)
attributes.ornament: Terracotta bookmark mark, arrow accents; cover type in HTML (Inter Black wordmark, Playfair Display italic subtitle)

exemplars.note: Cover of a placeholder 'top 3 browser-testing repos' test deck (real logo tile, HTML type) and slide 2 of a 'top 5 Claude Code front-end skills' deck.

requires: One Codex statue plate (SYSTEM + COVER + KEYING in the block), refs: kits/S06/samples/plate-cover.png (quality and slot only) and your latest S06 cover plate (do not repeat). Rotate statue, gesture and sky every deck and log the pair in storyboard.json style_notes; never reuse a pair
The held object is a real mark: kits/S06/tile.html on the cyan slot via composite.py --logo C1=…@1.07 (tile rendered at the slot aspect); never a painted or sculpted logo
Cover type in HTML: kits/S06/cover.html over fitted/slide-01.png (kicker, 1-2 line wordmark, italic subtitle; white on saturated skies, ink on pale)

Interiors from templates/01-graph-paper-cream ({{BRAND}} in the CTA handle replaced): captures saved in $D/assets/ (cropped clear of avatars and faces), repo card stars / language verified on posting day, the keyword CTA (ctaKeyword + ctaDeliverable; export.mjs exits 3 if it can't fit); the NN / TT counter and slide count come from slides.length
Stage 4 route in .claude/skills/carousel/SKILL.md

styles.name: Dark Network Hero
styles.one_line: Near-black glowing node network, giant white sans, app tile and brush label.

formats.notes: Single-tool reveal (A) or system reveal (D). Cover: 'name' (meet <NAME>) or 'icon' (/<command> over one big app tile). Interiors are network pages, not bare black: each plate paints a network figure that acts out the slide (two clusters for why, named communities for model, a thread into the terminal for peak) under a glass capture window, stat cells or a step rail. A: define, versus, parts, stage, terminal, receipts, steps, cta. D: the system's parts as the cover tile column, then stage / terminal / steps per step and receipts as the day. Not for listicles or head-to-heads.

attributes.ground: Near-black #06090B with a glowing node-and-hairline network: teal (#39C6BF) by default, warm 'ember' (terracotta / amber) as the alternative; calm dark space where type sits; no haze
attributes.type_pairing: Giant white Inter Black with a hard dark offset shadow ('meet <NAME>', '/<command>') + a white Inter ExtraBold brush label; interiors Inter Black headlines with one terracotta accent phrase, Inter body, JetBrains Mono section labels and counter
attributes.panel: Cover: real logo tile column or one big app tile. Interiors: one Codex network figure per slide (versus split, part clusters, converging stage bed, terminal thread, step chain) under glass capture windows with teal glow, stat cells, a terminal card or a numbered rail, all HTML
attributes.ornament: Dry-brush black label and dashed hand arrow (drawn by the kit), glowing node pins, perspective floor grid on the cover, mono tag line, '{{BRAND}}' footer
attributes.palette: Near-black / white / teal #39C6BF (or ember) / terracotta #D97757 accent

exemplars.note: Cover of a 'meet <NAME>' system-reveal deck (personal tag line blurred) and slide 3 of a /<command> memory-tool deck with dark S07 interiors.

requires: Hybrid, plate-first: one Codex network plate per slide (SYSTEM + COVER or the layout's INTERIOR figure in engine/styles/S07-dark-network-hero.prompt.md), no text and no key colours on the plate; ask for 'no haze' on every dark generation (the block does)
Refs: engine/styles/refs/s07-ref-teal.png (network crop) and s07-ref-ember.png (a text-free warm plate); never finished exports

Page kit: engine/styles/kits/S07/page.html sets every word, the brush label, logo tiles, capture windows, terminal and rail over the fitted plate, with the footer set to the brand in engine/brand.json; render-card 1080x1350 --scale 1 --min-px 22 straight to exports/. A parts plate whose clusters land off 47%/73% gets measured 'pos' in the page JSON
Real logo tiles in $D/logos/ (your own logo files or simple-icons SVGs) and real captures in $D/shots/; every stat a verified figure from the dossier

styles.name: Charcoal Studio

formats.notes: Tool tutorials and step-by-step builds. A: roadmap (what), tells (why), parts (model), step (how), prompt (peak), measured (use), stack (start), cta. D: the same step and prompt pages carry the N build steps, measured is the day. Not for listicles or head-to-heads.

attributes.type_pairing: #F2F0EA editorial serif headlines, Title Case, acid-yellow accent phrase with a hand-drawn marker underline; yellow mono eyebrows; Inter header and cards; marker script for stickies, the cover subline and swipe->
